verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents editing a repository, compiling, running tests and presenting a diff for review, plus a headless `exec` mode for CI. Nothing in the evidence shows it ingesting a tracked issue or opening a pull request, so the issue-to-PR workflow itself is unevidenced. Local diff generation is an adjacent capability, not the story's end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
